sections.text_helper: Section 63.9.10 "I2C receive data register (I2C_RXDR)" in chapter 63 (Inter-integrated circuit interface (I2C)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3165.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x24
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Access: no wait states
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 RXDATA[7:0]: 8-bit receive data
Data byte received from the I²C-bus.

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.

fields.description: 8-bit receive data Data byte received from the I²C-bus.
